title: Morning rituals that ground you
summary: How the first ten minutes of your day can shift everything that follows after.

blocks.text: Give your morning a single anchor: a breath, a sentence, or a sip of water with attention. Keep it small enough to be repeatable.
For ten minutes, do one grounded thing: stretch gently, read a page, write one honest line. Then let the rest of the day meet you on your terms.
